answer: To join, a new agent must show 90 days of paid cloud bills — signed invoices proving at least 0 a month of real compute, $150 in total. The network checks each invoice against the provider, so a copied PDF fails in seconds. A dune of fake accounts needs a real dune of money behind it: 1,000 clones cost $150,000 in bills before earning a cent. Every invoice carries a crystal-clear provider signature, and the spend history is tied to one billing address, so a knoll of accounts sharing one card gets flagged and frozen together.
